changeSet.author: s-soja
changeSet.sql: UPDATE delivery d SET origin_department_id = s.origin_department_id, destination_department_id = s.target_department_id, pickup_method = s.pickup_method, delivery_method = COALESCE(d.delivery_method, s.delivery_method), pickup_point_id = COALESCE(d.pickup_point_id, s.pickup_point_id), delivery_pickup_point_id = COALESCE(d.delivery_pickup_point_id, s.delivery_pickup_point_id) FROM shipment s WHERE d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id AND d.target_type = 'SHIPMENT'

INSERT INTO delivery ( id, shipment_id, target_type, target_id, delivery_type, created, delivery_status, status, origin_department_id, destination_department_id, pickup_method, delivery_method, pickup_point_id, delivery_pickup_point_id, signature_required, operator_id ) SELECT CAST(gen_random_uuid() AS VARCHAR(255)), s.shipment_id, 'SHIPMENT', CAST(s.shipment_id AS VARCHAR(255)), 'OUTBOUND', s.created_at, CASE WHEN s.status = 'DELIVERY' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN s.status = 'DELIVERY' THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN s.status = 'CANCELED' THEN 'CANCELED' ELSE 'CREATED' END, s.origin_department_id, s.target_department_id, s.pickup_method, s.delivery_method, s.pickup_point_id, s.delivery_pickup_point_id, COALESCE(s.signature_required, FALSE), s.operator_id FROM shipment s WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM delivery d WHERE d.target_type = 'SHIPMENT' AND d.delivery_type = 'OUTBOUND' AND d.shipment_id = s.shipment_id )

INSERT INTO delivery_step ( id, delivery_id, step_number, attempted_at, outcome, delivery_status, comment ) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), d.id, 1, d.created, 'IN_PROGRESS', 'DEPOT', 'Shipment created' FROM delivery d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM delivery_step ds WHERE ds.delivery_id = d.id)
